# API catalogue

<!-- Generated by scripts/build.js from data/api-catalogue.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Curated results only, last updated 2026-11-04. Every CORS result carries the date and method of the test. Candidates were taken from the providers' own documentation; the public API lists named in the brief are discovery sources only, never trusted providers. Rejected candidates and the reasons are in `research/rejected-apis.md`; the full scorecards are in `research/api-candidates.md`. The `api-discovery` skill searches this same data on the phone.

**Trust labels:** `trusted` = official provider, checked against its own documentation. `trusted-host-untrusted-content` = official host, but it returns text written by others (always treated as data). `untrusted` = catalogue listing only.

## Open-Meteo Forecast API

- id: `open-meteo-forecast`
- docs: https://open-meteo.com/en/docs
- terms: https://open-meteo.com/en/terms
- limits: <600/min, <5000/h, <10000/day, 300000/month per IP (terms page)
- commercial: non-commercial use only on the free tier
- attribution: required (CC BY 4.0)
- privacy: receives coordinates of the chosen place and the phone IP; logs deleted after 90 days
- key needed: none; HTTPS: yes
- CORS: pass, tested 2026-11-04, method: browser fetch from https://example.com plus curl with Origin header; not yet tested in Android WebView
- trust: trusted; verdict: yes-with-conditions

## Met Éireann Weather Warnings (national JSON, use warning_ALL.json)

- id: `met-eireann-warnings-json`
- docs: https://data.gov.ie/en_GB/dataset/weather-warnings
- terms: Met Éireann Custom Open Data Licence (CC BY 4.0 based): do not materially alter warning characteristics; keep current; acknowledge source
- endpoint: https://www.met.ie/Open_Data/json/warning_ALL.json
- limits: not stated
- commercial: allowed under the licence
- attribution: required (acknowledge Met Éireann)
- privacy: national file; no location sent
- key needed: none; HTTPS: yes
- CORS: pass-for-simple-GET, tested 2026-11-04, method: browser fetch from https://example.com; OPTIONS preflight returns 405
- trust: trusted; verdict: yes-with-conditions

## ExchangeRate-API open access

- id: `exchangerate-api-open`
- docs: https://www.exchangerate-api.com/docs/free
- terms: https://www.exchangerate-api.com/terms
- endpoint: https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/{CODE}
- limits: rate limited, no numeric quota published; HTTP 429 lifts after 20 minutes; docs suggest at most 1 request/hour if not cached for 24 h
- commercial: terms allow commercial and personal use; no redistribution
- attribution: required by the docs page: link "Rates By Exchange Rate API"
- privacy: receives the base currency code and the phone IP only
- freshness: updated once per day
- key needed: none; HTTPS: yes
- CORS: pass, tested 2026-11-04, method: browser fetch from https://example.com plus curl with Origin header; not yet tested in Android WebView
- trust: trusted; verdict: yes-with-conditions

## Wikipedia Portal:Current events via MediaWiki Action API

- id: `wikipedia-current-events`
- docs: https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/API:Main_page
- terms: CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Reusing_Wikipedia_content); etiquette https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/API:Etiquette
- endpoint: https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php (action=query, prop=revisions, titles=Portal:Current_events/YYYY_Month_D/..., origin=*)
- limits: no hard read limit; be considerate; serial requests; batch titles
- commercial: CC BY-SA 4.0
- attribution: required (link page URLs + licence statement)
- privacy: page titles (dates) and phone IP only
- freshness: edited continuously; current-day page may be a near-empty stub
- key needed: none; HTTPS: yes
- CORS: pass, tested 2026-11-04, method: browser fetch from https://example.com; preflight for Api-User-Agent passes; not yet tested in Android WebView
- trust: trusted-host-untrusted-content; verdict: yes-with-conditions

## GitHub REST API (unauthenticated, public repositories)

- id: `github-rest-unauthenticated`
- docs: https://docs.github.com/en/rest
- terms: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api
- endpoint: https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}[/releases/latest//commits//issues]
- limits: 60 requests per hour per IP unauthenticated; 403/429 when exceeded; secondary limits apply
- commercial: GitHub API terms
- attribution: none found
- privacy: receives the owner/repo names looked up and the phone IP
- freshness: Cache-Control public, max-age=60
- key needed: none; HTTPS: yes
- CORS: pass, tested 2026-11-04, method: browser fetch from https://example.com plus curl with Origin header; rate-limit headers exposed; not yet tested in Android WebView
- trust: trusted-host-untrusted-content; verdict: yes-with-conditions
